summaries.en: Deep-Live-Cam is an open-source tool enabling real-time face swapping and video deepfake generation using just a single reference image, making sophisticated AI manipulation accessible to developers and researchers. It leverages generative adversarial networks (GANs) and optimized processing pipelines to achieve seamless face replacement in live webcam feeds with minimal input requirements. Developers can integrate it into video applications, experiment with real-time AI synthesis, or study GAN-based facial manipulation techniques for creative or educational projects.
summaries.zh: Deep-Live-Cam 是一款开源实时人脸替换工具，仅需单张参考图像即可生成视频深度伪造效果，将复杂的AI换脸技术平民化。其核心采用生成对抗网络（GAN）架构，通过优化处理流程在实时网络摄像头流中实现无缝面部替换，技术亮点在于极简的输入要求下保持高质量输出。开发者可将其集成到视频应用中，探索实时AI合成技术，或基于GAN的面部操纵方法进行创意实验与算法研究，为多媒体开发提供实用参考。

summaries.en: Twenty is an open-source CRM platform that provides a community-driven alternative to proprietary systems like Salesforce, addressing the need for customizable and transparent customer relationship management. It's built as a TypeScript monorepo using NestJS and GraphQL, offering modular architecture that enables developers to extend functionality through plugins and integrations. You can deploy it with PostgreSQL for data storage, customize workflows for sales or marketing pipelines, or contribute to its development by tackling labeled issues on GitHub.
summaries.zh: Twenty 是一个开源 CRM 平台，旨在为 Salesforce 等专有系统提供由社区驱动的现代化替代方案，解决企业对可定制、透明客户关系管理工具的需求。该项目采用 TypeScript 单仓库架构，基于 NestJS 和 GraphQL 构建，其模块化设计允许开发者通过插件灵活扩展功能，例如集成营销自动化或自定义销售流程。你可以使用 PostgreSQL 部署它来管理客户数据，根据业务需求调整管道阶段，或参与社区开发，通过处理 GitHub 上标记的议题来改进功能。

summaries.en: Awesome Copilot is a community-curated collection of prompts, configurations, and techniques designed to maximize GitHub Copilot's effectiveness in code generation. It demonstrates how structured prompt engineering—like providing context, examples, and constraints—significantly improves AI-assisted coding accuracy and relevance. Developers can browse categorized examples to adapt proven patterns for their own workflows, experiment with different prompting strategies across languages, or contribute their own discoveries to help others write better code faster.
summaries.zh: Awesome Copilot 是一个社区驱动的资源库，汇集了优化 GitHub Copilot 使用的提示词、配置方案和实践技巧。它展示了如何通过精心设计的提示工程——例如提供上下文、示例和约束条件——来显著提升 AI 代码生成的准确性和实用性。开发者可以按类别浏览这些资源，学习如何为不同编程任务构造有效的提示，将其应用到日常编码中以探索更高效的协作模式，或贡献自己的经验来丰富这个不断成长的实用知识库。

summaries.en: OpenProject is an open-source project management platform that helps teams organize work from planning to delivery in one integrated system. It stands out by combining traditional methodologies like Gantt charts with agile tools like Kanban boards, enabling hybrid workflows. Developers can deploy it on-premises for full data control or extend its Ruby-based architecture to create custom modules for specialized project needs.
summaries.zh: OpenProject是一款开源项目管理软件，它将项目规划、任务跟踪和团队协作整合到统一平台中，解决传统工具分散导致的效率问题。其技术亮点在于融合了甘特图等传统方法和看板等敏捷工具，支持混合工作流设计。用户可自主部署保障数据安全，也可基于Ruby架构扩展模块，适用于建筑工程、软件开发等多种需要定制化管理的复杂项目场景。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
